source.title: Some open problems on holomorphic functions of one variable

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as one zbMATH resolver URL with document id 3925193.

Local resolver metadata identified the exact source as Jan Stankiewicz, Some open problems on holomorphic functions of one variable, Lecture Notes in Mathematics 1165, pages 281-282, 1985, with DOI https://doi.org/10.1007/BFb0076161.

Direct local fetches of https://zbmath.org/3925193, https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/3925193, and the zbMATH API search endpoint failed with DNS resolution errors in the restricted CLI environment. Browser/page-reader access to the exact zbMATH URL and DOI URL did not expose a readable primary source body.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact DOI, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus SpringerLink, the exact title plus author, and the Springer book DOI 10.1007/BFb0076141. Recovered candidates were rejected as metadata-only or non-primary for extraction: Springer and library/catalog pages exposed only table-of-contents or bibliographic metadata, and reference snippets did not contain the chapter's technical problem statements.

No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. Extracting from resolver metadata, catalog table-of-contents text, search snippets, or references in related papers would fail the source adequacy and evidence completeness gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/3925193.json and outputs/latest.json.
